functions.name: SetSkeletalMeshComponent
functions.docs: Sets the skeletal mesh we are driving through physical animation. Will erase any existing physical animation data.

functions.name: ApplyPhysicalAnimationSettings
functions.signature: ApplyPhysicalAnimationSettings(Target, Body Name, Physical Animation Data)
functions.docs: Applies the physical animation settings to the body given.

functions.name: ApplyPhysicalAnimationSettingsBelow
functions.signature: ApplyPhysicalAnimationSettingsBelow(Target, Body Name, Physical Animation Data, Include Self)
functions.docs: Applies the physical animation settings to the body given and all bodies below.

functions.name: SetStrengthMultiplyer
functions.docs: Updates strength multiplyer and any active motors

functions.name: ApplyPhysicalAnimationProfileBelow
functions.signature: ApplyPhysicalAnimationProfileBelow(Target, Body Name, Profile Name, Include Self, Clear Not Found)

functions.name: GetBodyTargetTransform
functions.docs: Returns the target transform for the given body. If physical animation component is not controlling this body, returns its current transform.
